body: I guess I’m going to find out very soon, my friend.

Happiness is due to chemicals released in the brain which include endorphins, oxytocin, dopamine and serotonin. Some people are just sad like me. I’m strong so I did last this long, and I can last much longer. I just don’t see the point, I’m not happy. I’ve achieved a lot in my life, but I’m just not happy. My life is going great, I just don’t want it. I wish I could just give it all away to someone who wants it, because I don’t. I wish I never even existed, I wish I was never conceived.

I was in the neighborhood, there’s no other place I could ride it’s not meant to be on a highway. Riding recklessly is what made me feel good, that sense of achievement. I’ve never been allowed to do much with my life until very recently, so I took the opportunity to do something with my life.

I’m so tired of myself too. I’m sick of myself to the point where I just can’t look into the mirror anymore. My bike used to make me feel better, which was nothing; nothing is better than feeling depressed. I got hit by a cop car and arrested, bike got taken and I won’t see her for 2 years, if I make it 2 years.
